source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 3961 test cleanup removes experimental.mail.ews.enabled from two account-hub browser setups and the historical EWS xpcshell manifest. It preserves mailnews.auto_config.fetchFromExchange.enabled and the local autoconfig settings, which control the discovery scenario separately. The patch changes setup only; it adds no result assertion. At the fixed accepted revision, the browser setup arrays still omit the old gate. The protocol manifest is now under protocols/exchange and has a separate Graph preference, so do not treat that later setting as part of this cleanup. Existing configuration-dependent EWS choice and profile-migration behavior remain covered by the linked production lesson. Static inspection does not establish test success.
title: EWS test setups keep discovery controls after the rollout preference is removed
